profiles.purpose: Current declared Thor SGLang baseline, not a claim that the service is running or that benchmark results have been measured.

Lazycat original application 0.2.8 SGLang deployment recorded on 2026-10-03, with HF target and draft/optimization revisions confirmed on 2026-10-04. Runtime tag, base version and build prefix are known, but the full engine Git SHA and image SHA-256 remain pending. NEXTN is configured, not proven effective: recorded acceptance was zero. This is not a new benchmark observation.

settings.target_head_quantization: FP8_PB_WO block128; checkpoint config/header only, vendor runtime representation unobserved

profiles.purpose: Owned NixOS/SGLang mixed-target-only short-input baseline. FP8 checkpoint/head payload is retained, with a strict TP1 block-scale loader fix. No MTP, no CUDA graphs, FP32 recurrent state and BF16 KV; not the planned all-BF16 dense-side F0 and not a long-context qualification.

Unmeasured C1 decodeGraph control generated from the S0 baseline by services.thorFlashNext.decodeGraph = true in flash-next.nix, not the original baseline JSON. Identical pins and non-graph settings to S0; only full decode graphs with maximum batch size 1 are enabled. Prefill graphs remain disabled, no MTP. No throughput or SM110 data-path validation is claimed.

Owned target-only baseline plus native NEXTN MTP with the separate full-vocabulary draft (3 steps, topk 1, 4 draft tokens), retaining C1 full decode graphs, BF16 KV and FP32 state. Full vocab means no speculative token map; the 32768-token optimization is not active.
M1 native NEXTN full-vocab MTP plus the Prometheus /metrics endpoint, so cumulative speculative acceptance counters can be captured over a workload window. Identical inference settings to M1.

M1M native NEXTN full-vocab MTP plus the 32768-token draft token map (optimization/vocab-32768-corpus.pt mounted at /vocab-maps). Compares the reduced-vocabulary draft head against M1M; the separate draft-head-32768-corpus-fp8.safetensors has no loader in this image and is not used.
M1M native NEXTN full-vocab MTP with the KV budget raised from 8192 to 32768 tokens for long-context retrieval checks. Inference settings otherwise identical to M1M.
State-precision axis: identical to M1M (native NEXTN full-vocab MTP, C1 decode graph, BF16 KV) except the recurrent SSM state is bfloat16 instead of float32 (--mamba-ssm-dtype bfloat16).
KV-precision axis: identical to M1M (native NEXTN full-vocab MTP, C1 decode graph, FP32 state) except the KV cache is fp8_e4m3 instead of bfloat16.
Long-context x FP8 KV: M1M native NEXTN full-vocab MTP with the KV budget raised to 65536 tokens and the KV cache in fp8_e4m3 (so total KV stays similar to L32's bfloat16).
BF16-KV long-context control for the FP8-KV quality comparison: M1M native NEXTN full-vocab MTP with max_total_tokens 65536 and bfloat16 KV (identical to L64K except KV dtype).
Prefill-chunk axis: identical to L64 (MTP, 65536, BF16 KV) except --chunked-prefill-size 1024, to measure 64K prefill scaling.
Prefill-chunk axis: identical to L64 (MTP, 65536, BF16 KV) except --chunked-prefill-size 2048, to measure 64K prefill scaling.
Prefill-chunk axis: identical to L64 (MTP, 65536, BF16 KV) except --chunked-prefill-size 4096, to measure 64K prefill scaling.
Long-context x FP8 KV at 131072 tokens: M1M native NEXTN full-vocab MTP with max_total_tokens 131072 and fp8_e4m3 KV, to probe the next capacity tier.

Long-context x FP8 KV at the declared context length: M1M native NEXTN full-vocab MTP with max_total_tokens 262144 (equal to context_length) and fp8_e4m3 KV, to probe the vendor's claimed context ceiling.
BF16-KV control at the full context: identical to L256K except the KV cache is bfloat16, to test whether 262144 needs FP8 KV or BF16 fits at C1.
Target-only long-prefill control: G1 (C1 full decode graph, no MTP) with max_total_tokens 65536, to attribute the 64K prefill time between target and MTP draft prefill.

Unrun SGLang Flash Next C1 target-only candidate without MTP. Use the pinned RadixArk weights with the pinned SGLang-Thor target configuration overrides, but do not activate a draft model. F0-F4 require a common full engine Git SHA and image SHA-256; requested FP32 state/BF16 dense side precision still needs implementation and artifact validation, not an assumed existing conversion.

Unrun SGLang same-source comparison against F0 with NEXTN: 3 steps, topk 1, 4 draft tokens. Use the pinned RadixArk target, SGLang-Thor target configuration overrides and separate SGLang-Thor MTP artifact; draft participation and acceptance need verification. Pin the common engine/image and implement/validate requested FP32 state/BF16 dense side precision before running; no valid conversion artifact is assumed.

Unrun SGLang same-source candidate comparing requested BF16 state with F1's FP32 state, retaining BF16 dense side precision and NEXTN 3 steps/topk 1/4 draft tokens. Use the same pinned RadixArk target, SGLang-Thor configuration overrides and MTP/optimization artifacts. Common engine/image pins and precision implementation/artifact validation remain pending; no valid BF16 conversion or quality equivalence is assumed.

Unrun SGLang same-source candidate comparing requested FP8 dense side precision with F1 while retaining FP32 state, BF16 target head and NEXTN 3 steps/topk 1/4 draft tokens. Use the same pinned RadixArk target and SGLang-Thor configuration/MTP/optimization artifacts. Common engine/image pins and precision implementation remain pending. No valid FP8 conversion exists in this declaration; validate it and record the exact target source revision and artifact SHA-256 before running.

Unrun SGLang same-source candidate comparing requested BF16 state with F3 while retaining its identical FP8 dense artifact, BF16 target head and NEXTN 3 steps/topk 1/4 draft tokens. Use the same pinned RadixArk target and SGLang-Thor configuration/MTP/optimization artifacts. Common engine/image pins and precision implementation/artifact validation remain pending; do not assume a valid BF16/FP8 conversion. Record the same target source revision and conversion artifact SHA-256 as F3 before running.
